profile_source: behaviors.history (clicks before the log period), never impression clicks

profile.weights: decay**k, k = 0 (weight 1) for the newest history item

measures.negkl: -KL(item || profile), eps 1e-06, vectors renormalised to sum 1

roles.raw: measure against the user's history profile
roles._generic: same measure against the corpus-mean profile (identical for every user)
roles._otheruser: measure against a random other impression's profile (seeded permutation, 42)
roles._userspecific: raw - _otheruser. Robustness control ADDED AFTER seeing results: corpus-mean 'generic' differs from the typical clicked-history profile, so _personal can be positive without personalisation; _userspecific removes that shared shift.

interpretation_rule: if raw is significant but _personal is not, the match is item emotion, not personalisation
method: as Phase 5: per-impression clicked-minus-unclicked mean difference, dz, one-sample t-test with Holm (one family per sample, exploratory measure included), user-level t-test with Holm, shuffled-label null; Wilcoxon robustness only.
direction_rule: dz > 0 and significant at both levels -> congruence-seeking; dz < 0 -> mood repair
limitations: no popularity control (LightGBM M4 vs M5 later)
MIND history is one fixed list per user, so profiles do not evolve within the log period
emotion tracks topic, so personal congruence may partly be topical similarity (M2 vs M3)
all-positive percentile vectors give high, compressed cosine values; dz is scale-free
